title: Windows shards start no idle runner when their flag is off
why: After #1627, the Windows merge shards 2-5 and guard shard 2 start a runner on every ready PR, even with their flag off (coordinator, 16:47 CST Nov 7).
note: Fix: build each shard family as one matrix from the flag ([1] when off), so no idle runner starts. The job-level if: rule (ci-hygiene step 19) and the all-jobs-passed ruling still hold. Done check: red tests in lint/test_windows_split.py and all_jobs_passed_rules.py, plus a measured wait before and after.
